newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes down at intra-day low vs US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes down at intra-day low vs US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan fell late in the session to close at an intra-day low at 8.2991 against the U.S. dollar on Monday due to intervention by the central bank, slightly down from last Friday's 8.2990, traders said.
The yuan opened higher at an intra-day high of 8.2975 and moved around 8.2980 for most of the session before falling to end at a low.
Trading was slow, with most done at 8.2985, traders said.
Dealers said it was only the People's Bank of China intervention which capped the yuan's upward trend late in trading.
"Today's movement was somewhat like last Friday, but the intervention by the central bank was more powerful and direct," said one dealer.
"The yuan will not be far away from the key 8.3000 level around the year-end due to the intervention," he added.
Dealers expect the yuan to move around 8.3000 on Tuesday, the last trading session of 1996.
The yuan closed slightly up at an intra-day high of 7.1600 from 7.2000 against 100 Japanese yen and up at 1.0726 from 1.0730 against the Hong Kong dollar.
